topic: Various checks on propeller on the ground during ground run
syllabus_extract: Various checks on propeller on the ground during ground run. General precautions to be observed while working on propeller, ground run
specific_objectives: 12.1.2.1 Trainee will be able to explain propellers and its associated maintenance practice

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Conduct ground run checks on propeller; observe safety precautions; instructor supervises procedure
intro_questions: What are the general precautions for working on a propeller?
Why is a ground run performed on a propeller?
List the key checks required during a ground run.

development.content:
General precautions for propeller maintenance
Safety measures during ground run
Pre-run inspection requirements
Engine start and idle procedures
Propeller rotation observation

Blade tracking and balance checks
Vibration monitoring during run
Oil seal and hub inspection
Governor operation verification
Post-run shutdown procedures

Recording ground run data
Defect identification criteria
Reporting maintenance discrepancies
Final clearance sign-off
Storage and protection measures

summary_questions: Explain the critical safety precautions during a propeller ground run.
Describe the procedure for identifying defects during the ground run.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the specific checks required for the next lesson plan (LP 02) regarding propeller in-flight performance.
